title: Songbook and Orchard
author: Mirabel Dunmore
blurb: Ada Voss, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, has spent twenty years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
